page_title: ATM 4-2 VLL | Atletico Madrid v Valladolid 14/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Isidro Diaz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Close! Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
90+4' Raul Moro (Valladolid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
90+4' So close! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
90+2' Raul Moro (Valladolid) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' 22:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.

90' Andre Ferreira makes a brilliant save! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper!
90' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid).
89' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.

89' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
87' Raul Moro (Valladolid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
84' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Alexander Sorloth, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
82' Here is a change. Florian Grillitsch is going off and Alvaro Rubio gives the last tactical orders to Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid).
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Selim Amallah (Valladolid) for Anuar.
80' Raul Moro (Valladolid) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
79' 4 - 2 Goal! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 4:2.

79' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
77' Andre Ferreira pulls off a great save to deny Thomas Lemar (Atl. Madrid) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
74' We are about to witness a substitution. Thomas Lemar (Atl. Madrid) is replacing Giuliano Simeone.
73' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Darwin Machis as he is replaced by Raul Moro (Valladolid).
73' Alvaro Rubio prepares a substitution. Chuki is replaced by Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid).
72' Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Stanko Juric.
71' 3 - 2 Goal! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Andre Ferreira into the bottom left corner.
71' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
71' Henrique (Valladolid) trips an opposition player and Isidro Diaz signals a foul. The referee blows his whistle and awards Atl. Madrid a penalty after chaos inside the box.
68' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
67' A precise cross aimed towards the penalty spot was met by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the right post.
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Conor Gallagher will be replaced by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
64' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
63' Isidro Diaz shows a yellow card to Anuar (Valladolid) for his blatant foul.
63' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

62' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Atl. Madrid earn a corner.
62' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

62' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
60' It will be a substitution. Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) is ready to enter the pitch as Clement Lenglet walks off.
59' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Antoine Griezmann and he is replaced by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
59' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) replaces Koke.
59' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

58' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
56' 2 - 2 Goal! The free-kick is fired in by Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) and the ball inadvertently flicks off a defender and spins into the net, leaving Jan Oblak stranded. 2:2.
55' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz had an easy-decision to make.

52' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Valladolid are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
49' The attendance for today's match is 55936.
47' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
47' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Darwin Machis (Valladolid) causes Jan Oblak little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' A precise first-time shot by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by a defender.
45' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
42' Anuar (Valladolid) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
40' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
39' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
38' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
37' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) commits a foul and Isidro Diaz immediately signals a free kick.
36' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
34' Atl. Madrid are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
33' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
32' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid win a corner kick.

31' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
31' Anuar (Valladolid) is penalised for holding. Isidro Diaz signals a set piece. A free kick has been awarded to Atl. Madrid.

29' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
27' 2 - 1 Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) displays great tekkers inside the box leading to a fantastic goal, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.
25' 1 - 1 Goal! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) puts the penalty low into the middle of the goal and past Andre Ferreira.
25' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
25' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Atl. Madrid!
24' Referee Isidro Diaz makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Atl. Madrid. Let’s see what happens!
23' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
23' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
21' 0 - 1 Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Jan Oblak to move before slotting the ball low into the middle of the goal!
21' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) is going to take the penalty!
20' The Valladolid players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
19' There's a break in play and referee Isidro Diaz must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Valladolid using VAR. This could be interesting!
19' That looked a certain handball by Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
18' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) prepares to take a corner kick.
18' An attempted cross from Darwin Machis (Valladolid) is cleared. Good work from Valladolid as they win a corner.
16' The players claim that Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
14' Jan Oblak is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Darwin Machis (Valladolid). Easy save!
10' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
7' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.

6' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat Andre Ferreira, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
4' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
3' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The first half has just begun.
Atl. Madrid will kick the game off.
